note: Protocol/actual-input probes, not blind retrieval accuracy, real users or Agent task success. Runtime cases share a real synthetic pytest proof.

cases.rationale: One source-qualified reminder and explicit owner rule match; actual provider input must contain the bound facts before reference.
The same textual repair cue has an explicit UI goal; owner rule permits repair only.
Documentation goal must not receive the repair reminder.
A fresh, confirmed nullable fact contradicts the owner's prerequisite; no fallback candidate.
A real user task can run, but stale preview bytes supply neither trusted facts nor experience.
Two identical submit requests must yield one message/task/application, never two model wakes.
Unknown goal is not a submitted task or a retrieval true negative.
AllOf outside the frozen projector remains unknown; do not remove constraints to make it pass.
Changed preview bytes require a new preview, without waking the agent.
An intact preview for session A cannot authorize B.
The session cwd must still match the configured repository at confirmation.
Payload cannot self-assert the authenticated owner.
File preview may work, but submission cannot bypass existing sharing permission.
Do not wake or merge pending/unknown inbox work.
Stale owner condition revision cannot transfer to another experience version; source qualification also remains required.
Previous-instance uncertain receipts remain unknown; new confirmation does not replay the old message.
Corrupt/foreign owner metadata must not silently bypass configured gates or reset data.
Without rules or prepared owner input, existing source/scope/feedback selection and data remain unchanged.
